decisions.statement: A reading runs from nought to seven.
A reading is read off the tree rather than folded again here.
The rows come in the order the book puts its parts in.
The last row is the whole book rather than a part.
A row is one part of the book rather than one topic beneath a part.
A count is every topic under a part.
The rows are padded into columns rather than parted by a mark.

definition: the command saying how far through Learn Everything Alan has got, part by part
